articles.summary: Hybrid working combines the mental health benefits of the best of both worlds: working at home and the office. Surveys show that this flexible option is a staff favorite.
articles.title: The Mental Health Benefits of Going Hybrid

articles.summary: There are definitely benefits for employees to get back into the office (at least part time) including increased Collaboration, Motivation and Friendships.
articles.title: Why it Makes Sense to Return to the Office (at least part time)
